title: Airspeed Indicator
description: An aircraft airspeed indicator: an arc sweeps over the speed bands with the live reading and turns red past the red line.

title: Attitude Indicator
description: An attitude indicator: the horizon pitches and banks behind a fixed aircraft symbol while a tilt table moves the unit.

title: Altimeter
description: An altimeter: an arc sweeps up to the live altitude while a cyan bug marks the selected one, and the reading stays in the center.

title: Turn Coordinator
description: A turn coordinator: the aircraft banks onto the standard-rate mark with the turn rate, and the ball slips in its tube.

title: Heading Indicator
description: A heading indicator: the compass card turns under the lubber line to the live heading, with a cyan bug on the selected one.

title: Vertical Speed Indicator
description: A vertical speed indicator: an arc fills up from zero in a climb and down in a descent, and turns red past the sink rate limit.

title: Battery Cycler Channel
description: The front panel of a battery cycler channel: terminal voltage and current on a fluorescent display, the CC and CV mode, the direction, and the overcurrent trip.

title: Battery HiTester
description: An AC internal resistance meter on the pack: resistance at 1 kHz and voltage on a reflective LCD, with the HI, IN and LO comparator lamps.

title: Temperature Scanner
description: An 8-channel thermocouple scanner on the cells, the busbar and the coolant, with each channel's alarm against the limit of the step being run.

title: State of Charge
description: State of charge as the cycler's software shows it: a large reading, twenty segments that go amber then red when low, and the charge moved so far.

title: Cell Voltage Balance
description: The 13 cells as the BMS view shows them: each cell's deviation from the pack mean, the cells being balanced, and the spread against its limits.

title: Charge and Discharge
description: The cycler software's plot of the run: pack voltage and current as the cycle goes, over the faint profile still to come.

title: Vacuum Gauge Controller
description: A thermal vacuum chamber's gauge controller through a pump-down: a full-range gauge and a Pirani that goes underrange, with the setpoint relays the test waits on.

title: Thermal Controller
description: A thermal vacuum chamber's programmer running one protoflight cycle on a unit's baseplate: process value in red, setpoint in green, heat and LN2 outputs, and the deviation alarm.

title: Spectrum Analyzer
description: The RF checkout spectrum analyzer on a spacecraft's S-band downlink: the noise floor, then the QPSK carrier rising out of it, with the marker on the peak.

title: Spacecraft Power Supply
description: The EGSE supply feeding a spacecraft's 28 V bus: voltage and current through switch-on, the inrush, and the load steps as subsystems power up.

title: Random Vibration
description: The vibration controller's PSD screen through a run at −12, −6, −3 dB and full level: reference, ±3 dB tolerance and ±6 dB abort lines, and the control spectrum.

title: Reaction Wheels
description: Reaction wheel speeds from spacecraft telemetry during an attitude control test: four wheels in a pyramid on center-zero bars, amber near saturation, red past it.

title: Digital Multimeter
description: A 6½-digit multimeter's display behind a scanner card, stepping through a board's four rails with each rail's ±3 % limit and verdict.

title: Triple-Output Power Supply
description: A triple-output supply's display as its channels switch on: set point, volts, amps and watts per channel, and the CV or CC badge when a current limit is reached.

title: Oscilloscope
description: A 4-channel oscilloscope's screen on a board's power-up: VBUS, the 3.3 V regulator, the MCU leaving reset, then an LED when the firmware boots, captured on a single trigger.

title: Test Point Probing
description: A board's bottom side drawn from its KiCad layout, with a bed-of-nails fixture probing its 19 test points in turn: each one turns green within its level or red outside it, and the probe shows the net and the reading.

title: Board View
description: A board's top side drawn from its KiCad layout, the way an interactive BOM shows it: each step of the functional test lights the parts it checks and names the result.

title: Relay Matrix
description: A 4 x 16 crosspoint switch matrix routing a multimeter to a board's test nodes one at a time: ABUS1 to the node, ABUS2 to ground, each closed crosspoint lit.

title: LED Color
description: An LED analyzer's reading of a board's eight LEDs on the CIE 1931 chromaticity diagram: each LED's point drops into its bin, the ANSI 5700 K quadrangle for the white one.

title: Bourdon Pressure Gauge
description: A Bourdon tube gauge on a pressure-decay leak test: the part fills to 6 bar, settles and holds while the decay is measured, then vents, with the red drag pointer keeping the peak.

title: Moving-Coil Ammeter
description: A moving-coil DC panel ammeter, 0 to 5 A on a 90° scale with a mirror band, reading a product's supply current as its stages switch on; the needle overshoots and settles like a damped movement.

title: Chart Recorder
description: A two-pen paper chart recorder on a climatic chamber: temperature in red, humidity in blue, the paper feeding down as the chamber runs a cold soak and a damp-heat dwell.

title: Force Gauge
description: A digital force gauge on a test stand pushing a connector into its header: live force and the held peak on the LCD, and the force against travel with the insertion window.

title: Electronic Load
description: A DC electronic load discharging a 12 V, 7.2 Ah lead-acid battery at C/10 in constant current down to the 10.5 V cutoff: volts, amps, watts, amp-hours and elapsed time.

title: LED Level Meter
description: A two-channel LED level meter on an amplifier's outputs while a 1 kHz tone steps up to the +4 dBu nominal level: green below 0 dBu, amber to +6, red above, with a peak-hold segment.

title: Alarm Annunciator
description: A test station's alarm annunciator through one incident: LOW AIR comes in first and flashes fast, VAC LOSS follows and flashes slow, both turn steady once acknowledged, then clear.

title: Burn-in Heat Map
description: A thermal camera's view of a board in burn-in, laid over its KiCad layout: the MCU and the regulator heat up, and the hottest point is marked with its temperature.

title: USB 2.0 Eye and Mask
description: A USB 2.0 high-speed data line folded into an eye on the oscilloscope, traces fading with persistence, against the hexagonal Template 1 mask and the level limits.

title: Antenna Match on a Smith Chart
description: A vector network analyzer's S11 sweep of a 2.4 GHz antenna on the Smith chart: the trace curls toward the centre as the matching network is tuned, with the 2.45 GHz marker and the VSWR 2 circle.

title: 16-QAM Constellation
description: A vector signal analyzer's 16-QAM constellation while a power amplifier is tuned: the symbol clouds tighten around the ideal points as the error vector magnitude falls under its limit.

title: I²C Logic Capture
description: A logic analyzer capturing a TMP117 temperature read on I²C: SCL and SDA drawn as the capture sweeps across, the decoded address, register and data bytes above, and the temperature they encode.

title: Calibration Rig
description: A fixed camera on an end-of-line calibration rig: four ChArUco targets tilted on an aluminium frame, their markers then their corners detected target by target, ending in the camera's calibration.

title: Chessboard Detection
description: A chessboard target on a tilt stage, its 9 x 6 inner corners found row by row and joined the way OpenCV draws them.

title: ChArUco Board
description: A ChArUco board on a rotary stage: its ArUco markers found first, then the chessboard corners between them, then the board's pose as three axes.

title: ArUco Markers
description: Six ArUco markers on a fixture plate: each one outlined as it is identified, then its pose drawn as three axes.

title: Reprojection Error
description: The calibration's reprojection error: one bar per rig target against the 0.5 px limit, and every corner's residual in a scatter around zero.

title: Camera Extrinsics
description: The rig as the calibration places it in 3D, seen from behind the camera: the camera's field of view and each target at its measured position and tilt.

title: Wafer Map
description: A 200 mm wafer being probed: the 2 x 2 probe card steps row pair by row pair in a serpentine, and each die takes its bin color as it is tested, edge fails and a scratch included.

title: Probe Card Touchdown
description: A 2 x 2 multi-site cantilever probe card seen through its window during wafer sort: each site under the needles takes the bin color of its die at every touchdown, with the touchdown's test time.

title: Parametric Wafer Map
description: Each die's threshold voltage measured during wafer sort, drawn on the wafer as a heat map from 430 to 460 mV: the radial rise toward the edge shows up as the probe card steps across.
